attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2617/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole text is the one sentence quoted in the life. No year, so no `dates` object; the see is recorded in `office` because the line gives it, and Novgorod gets no coordinate. No hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
